# Documentation templates

Copy a template when creating the corresponding record; replace every placeholder and preserve requirement/acceptance identifiers across revisions.

- [Micro-specification](micro-spec-template.md)
- [Implementation report](implementation-report-template.md)
- [Test results](test-results-template.md)
- [Architectural decision record](adr-template.md)

Templates are conventions for this repository, not installed tools or additional infrastructure. See [reporting and decisions](../standards/reporting-and-decisions.md) for lifecycle rules.
